newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares tread water in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares tread water in dull trade.

text.p: Norwegian share prices were little changed on Friday with turnover tumbling 25 percent from a day earlier as investors waited for U.S. jobless data.

Brokers said the U.S. figures, which were slightly lower than expected, were likely to put downward pressure on the market next week. Activity was expected to remain guarded with attention focused on the U.S. interest rates.
Oslo Total share index ended the week at 828.46 points, a rise of 0.1 percent. Turnover was a dull 452 million crowns.
Norway's largest life insurance group UNI Storebrand fell 1.12 percent following news that two of its major shareholders must reduce their stakes in the company by year-end under Norwegian law.
UNI relinquished 0.40 crowns to close at 35.40 crowns.
Pharmaceuticals company Nycomed recovered after taking heavy losses on Thursday on rumours of a renewed price war in the U.S. market for X-ray diagnostic imaging agents.
Nycomed A put on four crowns to end at 76 crowns, while the B's gained 4.50 crowns to 74 crowns.
